title: Osmantic/ODS

title: Dezz05/AuraSDK
description: Enable fast, local memory recall for AI agents using a lightweight, Rust-based cognitive memory engine with no cloud or LLM calls needed.

title: bedda-tech/react-native-device-agent
description: On-device AI agent loop for React Native. Connects LLM inference with phone control for autonomous task execution. Works with Gemma 4, Claude, or any LLM.

title: weam-ai/weam

title: XAIHT/Tlamatini
description: Tlamatini is a self-hosted AI developer assistant for local or cloud LLMs: hybrid RAG over your codebase, a 79-tool multi-turn engine, a 74-agent visual workflow designer, and ACPX, a runtime for external coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini CLI.

title: alexharrison-js/StudyPlanner
description: This is a free-tier focussed system for personal study planning including new information intake for current/evolving topics (like AI research or programming), curriculum adjustment and planning for offine-study (languages, music, art), and spatial repetition. title: OrbitFlow-AI/AI-Engine
description: An **AI Agent Treasury & Micropayment Router**. A specialized Soroban smart contract framework built specifically for multi-agent LLM systems. title: AgentParadise/agentic-primitives
description: Composable building blocks for AI coding agents. Model-agnostic prompts and tools that work with Claude, GPT, or any LLM provider.

title: mockagents/mockagents
description: Simulate, test, and validate AI agent integrations — without calling real LLMs or burning tokens.

title: Resolve-public/writing-assistant-chat
description: AI writing assistant for Obsidian with chat, plan, and edit modes. Connects to local or cloud LLM providers. Features vault-wide RAG retrieval, knowledge graph, agentic tool use, note context, and reusable prompt commands.

title: JetBrains/junie

title: Tariux/AI-Skills-Not-Awesome
description: A curated collection of operational system prompts and behavioral patterns for AI assistants, LLM agents, and prompt engineers. Each `.skill.md` file can be injected as a primary system instruction to enforce specific reasoning, execution, or formatting behaviors.

title: kreivetech/uneven-agent
description: AI agent for developers. Indexes your codebase, watches running terminals to auto-fix errors in real time, scans dependencies for malware, and performs security tests. Run it locally or via cloud LLM APIs.

title: api-evangelist/stackone
